definitions.gloss: the masses; the populace; the common people
definitions.explanation: The general population viewed collectively, especially in contrast to the ruling class or authorities. Often used in historical, political, and social contexts to refer to ordinary citizens as a group.

examples.japanese: {民衆|みんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧。
examples.english: To listen to the voice of the people.

examples.japanese: {民衆|みんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がり→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧、⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The masses rose up and the revolution began.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{名|な}もなき→名もなき：21945_namonaki⟧{民衆|みんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{営|いとな}み→営み：11904_itonami⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{作|つく}られて→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧きた。
examples.english: History has been shaped not only by those in power but also by the efforts of nameless common people.

notes:
USAGE:
{民衆|みんしゅう} views people as a collective social force, often in opposition to authority. Compare with ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧ (the people of a nation, citizens), which is a more neutral, legal/political term, and ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧ (citizens, civilians), which emphasizes civic participation. {民衆|みんしゅう} has a more dramatic, sometimes literary tone and is common in historical narratives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {民衆|みんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: the voice of the people
- {民衆|みんしゅう}{蜂起|ほうき}: popular uprising
- {民衆|みんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いる→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧: to lead the masses
- {民衆|みんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧: popular support
